scope: Detection policy evaluation, explicit human review decisions, and delivery-safe separation of policy verdict from exception approval

red_evidence.reason: the detection policy, review approval, and policy schema modules were absent

assertions: the default policy requires review and contains no invented threshold
failed, blocked, unknown, or not-evaluable detection cannot pass policy
threshold fields retain their declared semantics and invalid thresholds are not evaluable
a human exception preserves the original not-met verdict
model self-approval and stale policy-version approval are rejected
review records bind actor, action, reason, policy version, and decision time

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy

live_blocker: Policy behavior is verified locally, but no authorized live report was evaluated and production admission remains blocked.
